entry_js_first_pass.meaning: Alias substitution selects JS; P1/P2 refuse because the complete local/ancestor/@types/typeRoots priority-pass absence proof fails.
entry_js_first_pass.faithful_ts_port: YES for a readable indexed native JS winner; distinguish an actual TS/declaration winner from conservative occupancy.

hop_js_first_pass.meaning: A relative JS candidate exists, but its local Node10 priority-pass absence proof fails.
hop_js_first_pass.faithful_ts_port: CONDITIONAL: can prove the native source winner; declaration winners must remain refusals.

nonrelative_hop.meaning: Export/import-forward module literal is bare or aliased; P2's relative-only callback rejects it before lookup.
nonrelative_hop.faithful_ts_port: YES for supported paths/baseUrl/package lookup with source custody; retain caller project options across barrels.

package_directory_redirect.meaning: prove_path sees package.json at the candidate directory and refuses before reading main/types/typesVersions or index.
package_directory_redirect.faithful_ts_port: YES for bounded readable Node10 redirects; types/declaration-only results are not executable callable authority.

explicit_extension_literal.meaning: Entry prove_path rejects a known non-TS extension, or a relative explicit JS/TS literal is unavailable. Relative indexed literal JS is already admitted by P2.
explicit_extension_literal.faithful_ts_port: YES with separate paths-literal and relative-suffix rules; substitutions and appended extensions can win.

directory_literal.meaning: Specifier or alias substitution ends in slash or slash-dot; refused before directory lookup.
directory_literal.faithful_ts_port: YES for readable bounded package/index resolution.

candidate_competition.meaning: More than one file/index/extension candidate exists, or an explicit TS hop has a competing sibling; prism requires a singleton instead of applying TS precedence.
candidate_competition.faithful_ts_port: YES; ordered file-before-directory and suffix precedence can prove a source winner.

declaration_priority.meaning: A declaration or unknown-suffix declaration competitor blocks prove_path.
declaration_priority.faithful_ts_port: CONDITIONAL: a native declaration winner cannot certify a source callable; source winners require ordered resolution.

source_custody.meaning: Snapshot incomplete, opaque/outside path, or winner not indexed; exact gate histogram distinguishes them.
source_custody.faithful_ts_port: NO by resolver port alone; custody/index coverage is a separate contract.

candidate_absent.meaning: Bounded candidate list is empty, or extensionless literal file blocks lookup; native may resolve an unsupported extension/redirect.
candidate_absent.faithful_ts_port: CONDITIONAL on an indexed source winner; no callable proof for true absence.

config_or_alias_gate.meaning: Prism cannot select/admit config or alias pattern before candidate lookup; exact gate histogram names the refusal.
config_or_alias_gate.faithful_ts_port: CONDITIONAL; pattern/options ports can help, ownership doubt stays refused.

ambient_competition.meaning: Captured ambient module pattern matches the alias and vetoes entry.
ambient_competition.faithful_ts_port: NO by filesystem resolution alone; requires program-scoped declaration/binding proof.

allow_js_off.meaning: The selected config lacks literal allowJs=true at a JS entry/hop.
allow_js_off.faithful_ts_port: CONDITIONAL; TS checker knowledge of JS does not itself grant the existing indexing/allowJs contract.

export_depth_limit.meaning: A third export/import-forward/star hop exceeds MAX_REEXPORT_DEPTH=2 before module resolution.
export_depth_limit.faithful_ts_port: YES for finite unique export graphs using memoized symbol/identity closure; increasing the constant is not a TS port.

export_cycle.meaning: An active file/export-name pair repeats in bounded export lookup.
export_cycle.faithful_ts_port: CONDITIONAL: SCC/fixed-point export closure can prove cycles with a unique terminal; empty/ambiguous cycles remain refused.

star_competition.meaning: Conflicted raw named claims or multiple distinct star terminal identities poison export lookup.
star_competition.faithful_ts_port: NO for a real TS2308 ambiguity; YES only where TS precedence or identical-symbol deduplication proves uniqueness.

unresolved_star_branch.meaning: A callable was found but skipped_star marks a missing/opaque/unresolved branch; alias query rejects via_unresolved_star.
unresolved_star_branch.faithful_ts_port: CONDITIONAL: prove branch absence under TS export semantics; checker first-wins lookup alone is insufficient.

import_forwardability.meaning: ImportForward reaches a terminal outside forwardable_function_locals, e.g. an arrow instead of a top-level function declaration.
import_forwardability.faithful_ts_port: NO by module resolver alone; YES with source-backed callable and unwritten-binding proof across forwarding.

export_fact_gap.meaning: Missing file/name fact, UnprovenLocal, or non-callable class projection prevents an export-table terminal.
export_fact_gap.faithful_ts_port: NO by module resolver alone; an AST/export proof extension may prove supported syntax.

terminal_span_gate.meaning: Export resolves to Local without an exact callable span; alias projection refuses name-only authority.
terminal_span_gate.faithful_ts_port: NO by module resolver alone; source-backed span capture can prove a unique callable.

binding_or_site_guard.meaning: Import binding eligibility/kind/ESM provenance or site Unproven(import) guard refuses before alias use.
binding_or_site_guard.faithful_ts_port: NO by module resolver alone; preserve binding writes/shadows and prove any new site form separately.

wrapped_non_jsx.meaning: Wrapped React callable is projected at an ordinary call site; current contract admits it only at JSX sites.
wrapped_non_jsx.faithful_ts_port: NO; this is a site policy, not module resolution.

terminal_function_lookup.meaning: Proven export span has zero or multiple matching FunctionIds; callable projection cannot select one.
terminal_function_lookup.faithful_ts_port: NO by module resolver alone; repair callable capture only after source-specific diagnosis.

post_export_site_gate.meaning: Entry, export closure, provenance and callable lookup pass, but supplied P2 site output is not native exact binding. This is explicitly unresolved query-level diagnosis, not an explained resolver refusal.
post_export_site_gate.faithful_ts_port: UNKNOWN; requires a narrower site-query trace before planning.
